full_prompt:
Draw exactly ONE Small Seal glyph U+3D06B.
The supplied chart shows FOUR historical views of the SAME ONE Small Seal character, ordered THX, CCZ, QJZ, DYC. Compare EVERY available witness equally; any slot marked unavailable provides no evidence. Create ONE newly drawn, coherent contemporary sans-serif/Gothic glyph informed by all witnesses, selecting ONE coherent attested construction where variants differ. Never combine incompatible components or replace this with modern Chinese. Trace the real continuous writing-stroke courses using smooth rounded curves and appropriate straight segments; preserve all meaningful branches, legs, bars, counters, crossings, attachments and detachments. Each intentional stroke has the SAME CONSTANT width, approximately 3% of the full canvas, with rounded caps and joins. No brush taper, thick/thin pressure, serifs, texture, ink blobs, doubled outlines or ornamental seal effects. Output exactly ONE complete glyph, black on transparent alpha, centered within the central70% of a square canvas with generous clear margins. No reference copies, four-character layout, labels, text, frames, grid, backdrop or shadows.
STRICT PROPORTION AND STRUCTURAL READING:
1. THX/CCZ/QJZ available; DYC blank. Upper peaked bowl and lower three-bar stem motif remain completely separate.
2. Upper bowl has THREE upward tips: left/right side tips and a higher central apex tick. Peaked roof connects sides. Exactly TWO inner horizontal chords produce exactly THREE closed white counters: triangular top, narrow middle, rounded bottom.
3. CRITICAL WIDTH RELATION from all available witnesses: UPPER BOWL IS NARROWER THAN EVERY ONE OF THE THREE LOWER BARS, including the shortest middle bar. Target upper bowl outside width approximately70% of lower baseline width. Do not make bowl as wide as lower bars.
4. Composition example: upper bowl occupies x33%–67% of full canvas (34%canvas width); lower baseline occupies x25.5%–74.5% (49%canvas width). Ratio0.69. Center both at50%. Upper bowl's side tips/roof stay within the narrow bowl's side boundaries.
5. Lower bars: baseline longest, upper about90% baseline, middle about83% baseline. Thus even shortest lower bar is noticeably WIDER than upper bowl. Vertical stem joins all three and stops at outer bars; lower gap larger than upper.
6. Preserve all three upper counters, three crown tips and detached inter-component gap. Change width relationship without adding any writing course or altering topology.
Main correction: make upper bowl visibly NARROW, about70%of lowerbaseline; ALL THREE lower bars wider than bowl. Maintain narrow bowl's correct THREE white fields and THREE upward tips. Faithful whole-form reading from all3 historical sources, not a wide modern crown. Real uniform technical-pen paths with roundcaps.
